title: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Dr. Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences
Ordinance, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
2. Definitions.‑‑In
this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑‑
(a) "Academic Board"
means the Academic Board of the Institute;
(b) "Board" means the
Board of Governors;
(c) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of the Board;
(d) "Controller of
Examination" means the Controller of Examinations of the Institute;
(e) "Director" means
the Director of the Institute;
(f) "Director
Finance" means the Director Finance of the Institute;
(g) "Government"
meant the Government of Sindh.
(h) "Institute" means
Dr. Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences established under this
Ordinance:
(i) "Member" means a
member of the Board;
(j) "Patron" means
the Governor of Sindh;
(k) "prescribed"
means prescribed by rules framed under this Ordinance;
(1) "Selection
Boards" means the Selection Board of the Institute;
(m) "Trust" means Dr.
Ziauddin Hospital Trust.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Establishment of institute

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
3. Establishment of
Institute.‑(1) There shall be established an Institute to be called
Dr. Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Karachi.
(2) The Institute shall be a7
body, corporate by the name of Dr. Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical
Sciences, Karachi and shall have perpetual succession and a common seal and
shall by the said name, sue and be sued.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Powers and function of the institute

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
4. Powers and function of the Institute.‑‑The Institute
shall have the power‑‑‑
(a) to provide for teaching,
training, research and demonstration in the health sciences leading to the
following post graduate degrees/diplomas:‑‑
(1) M.D.
(2) M.S.
(3) D. G. O..
(4) DCH
(5) DMRD
(6) DCP
(b) to make provision for
research, management, development programmes. for the advancement and
dissemination of knowledge in such manner as it may determine;
(c) to prescribe courses of
studies to be conducted by it and its affiliated institutions;
(d) to hold examinations and to
award and confer degrees, diplomas, certificates and other academic
distinctions to and on persons who have been admitted to have passed its
examinations under prescribed conditions;
(e) to affiliate and
disaffiliate institutions under prescribed conditions;
(f) to accept the examinations
passed and the periods of study spent by students at other hospitals and
institutes and places of learning as equivalent to such examinations and
periods of study in the Institutions as it may determine, and to withdraw such
acceptance;
(g) to create posts . of
teaching, research, training, consultancy, administration and other related
purposes and to appoint persons thereto;
(h) to establish centres of
learning for the development of teaching and research and to make such
arrangements for their. maintenance, management and .‑:p administration
as it may determine;
(i) to make provision for
research, consultancy and advisory services and with these objects to enter
into arrangements with other institutions or with public and private bodies
under prescribed conditions;
(j) to promote cooperation will
Government, national and international organizations, institutes and
universities in activities falling within the purview of the institute;
(k) to do all such other acts
and things, as may be necessary in order to further the objectives of the
Institute as a place of education, learning, research and consultancy;
(1) The Principal teaching
facilities of the health science facilities of the Institute shall consist of
Dr. Ziauddin Hospital and its affiliated hospital and centres.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Institute open to all

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
5. Institute open to ill.‑‑The Institute shall be open to
all persons of either sex and whatever religion, race, creed, caste, colour or
domicile who are academically qualified for admission to the courses of study
offered by the Institute and no such person shall be denied the privilege on
the ground only of sex, religion, race, caste, creed, colour or domicile.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Patron

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
6. Patron.‑‑(1) The Governor of Sindh shall be the Patron
of the Institute.
(2) The Patron shall, when
present, preside at the convocation of the Institute.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Chairman

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
7. Chairman.‑‑(1) The Chief Trustee of the Trust shall
be the Chairman and the Controlling Authority of the Institute.
(2) If the Chairman is
satisfied that the proceedings of the Board, Selection Board, or the Academic
Board are not in accordance with the provision of this Ordinance he may after
calling upon such Board to show‑cause why such proceedings should not be
annulled by order in writing, annul the proceedings.
(3) In the absence of the
Patron, the Chairman shall preside the convocation.
(4) The Chairman may cause a
visitation or enquiry to be respect of any matter connected with the affairs of
the person or persons as he may deem fit for the purpose.
(5) The Chairman shall on issue
such directions as he thinks directives.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Director post graduate studies

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
8. Director Post‑graduate studies.‑‑(1) The Director
shall be appointed by the Chairman who shall hold office during this pleasure
and unless removed earlier hold office for a period of four years on such terms
and conditions as may be determined by the Chairman.
(2) The Director shall be the
Chief Executive of the Institute having authority over academic and
administrative affairs and shall ensure that the provisions of this Ordinance
and the rules are faithfully observed.
(3) The Director may in an
emergency, which in his opinion requires immediate action, take such action as
he may consider necessary and shall, as soon as possible thereafter report his
action to the Board.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Director finance

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
9. Director Finance.‑‑(l)
The Director Finance shall be appointed by the Chairman on such terms and
conditions as may be determined by him.
(2) The Director Finance shall‑‑
(a) manage the property,
finances and investments of the Institute;
(b) prepare the annual and
revised budget estimates of the Institute and present them to the Board for
approval; '
(c) ensure that the funds of
the Institute are spent for the purpose for which they are provided; .
(d) perform such other duties
as may be prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
The controller of examination

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
10. The Controller of Examination.‑‑The Controller of
Examination shall be appointed by the Chairman and will be responsible for all
matters connected with the conduct of examination and be responsible for
keeping its record properly and shall perform such other duties as may be
prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Board of governors

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
11. Board of Governors.‑‑(1) There shall be Board of
Governors, consisting of the following:‑‑
(a) The Chief Trustee of the
Trust. Chairman
(b) The Vice‑Chancellor;
University of Karachi. Member
(c) A Judge of the Sindh High
Court nominated
by the Chief Justice. Member
(d) The Director. Member
(e) One nominee of the
University Grants
Commission not below the rank of a,
Whole time Member. Member
(f) One Dean to be nominated by
the Chairman Member
(g) Two prominent citizens to
be nominated
by the Chairman. Member
(h) One representative of the
Health Department Member
(i) One representative of the
Pakistan Medical
and Dental Council. Member
(2) The members, other than ex
officio members, shall hold office during the pleasure of the Chairman and
unless removed earlier shall hold office for three years commencing from the
date of the first meeting of the Board.
(3) A member other than ex officio
member shall cease to hold office if he does not attend three consecutive
meetings of the Board without any valid reason.
(4) The meetings of the Board
shall be presided over by the Chairman or in his absence by one of the members
to be nominated by the Chairman or in his absence by one of the members to be
elected by the members present:
(5) The Board. shall meet at
least twice a year on the dates to be fixed by the Director in consultation
with the Chairman.
(6) Tile quorum for a meeting
of the Board shall be one‑half of the total number of members, a fraction
being counted as one.
(7) The decisions of the Board
shall be expressed in terms of the views of the majority of the members present
and voting and in case of tie, the person presiding the meeting shall have and
exercise a casting vote.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Powers and function of the board

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
12. Powers and function of the Board.‑‑(1) The Board shall
be the policy formulation and executive body of the Institute and shall,
subject to the provisions of this Ordinance, and the due exercise general
supervision over the affairs of the Institute.
(2) In particular and without
prejudice to the generality of the foregoing provisions, the Board shall have
the powers‑‑
(a) to exercise overall control
over the Institute;
(b) to appoint the teachers and
other offices/staff of the Institute arid to determine the terms and conditions
of their services;
(c) to cause proper books of
accounts to be kept for all sums of money received and expended by the Institute
and for assets and liabilities of the Institute;
(d) to consider and approve the
budget estimates, annual research programmes, annual reports and audited
statements of accounts bf the Institute;
(e) to re-appropriate funds
from one major head of expenditure to another;
(f) to enter into, vary, carry
out and cancel contracts on behalf of the Institute;
(g) to institute professorships
including Professor Emeritus, associate professorships, assistant
professorships, lecturerships and other administrative posts and to appoint
persons thereto on the recommendation of the Selection Board;
(h) to receive and manage
property transferred and grants, bequests, trusts, gifts, donations, endowments
and other contributions, made to the Institute and to invest any fund
representing such property, grants, bequests, trusts, gifts, donations,
endowments or contributions in such manner as it may deem fit;
(i) to prescribe terms and
conditions of teaching and non‑teaching employees of the Institute,
including their qualifications, experience and eligibility for appointment;
(j) to delegate any of its
powers to the Director or a committee appointed by the Chairman, or any other
officer excepting the power of approval of budgetary estimates;
(k) to approve, appointments of
member of various Boards in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance.
(1) to appoint Auditors for the
annual audit of the accounts of the Institute;
(m) to suspend, punish and
remove from service, in the prescribed manner, employees appointed by the
Board;
(n) to frame rules as are
necessary for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance;
(o) to regulate, determine and
administer all other matters concerning the Institute and exercise all other
powers in this _ behalf not specifically mentioned in this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Academic boards

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
13. Academic Boards.‑‑(1) The Academic Board shall consist
of the following:‑‑
(a) The Director of the
Institute; Chairman
(b) The Deans and the Professors
of the
Institute (including Professor
Emeritus); Member
(c) The Controller of
Examination. Member
(d) Two persons of eminence of
Medical Science/related disciplines to be nominated by the Board on the
recommendation of the Director for three years.
(2) The Academic Board shall be
responsible for all academic matters including courses, syllabi, examinations,
degrees, diplomas and certificates and matters connected therewith.
(3) The meetings of the
Academic Board shall be held as frequently as possible, but not less than twice
in a year.
(4) The quorum of a meeting
shall be one‑half of the total number of the members.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Selection board

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
14. Selection Board.‑‑(1) All appointments on posts in the
teaching faculty shall be made by the Board on the recommendation of the
Selection Board consisting of the following:.‑‑
(i) The Chairman.
(ii) The Director.
(iii) Three Professors
nominated by the Academic Board.
(iv) Two persons of eminence
who shall not be employees of the Institute
(2) All other appointments
shall be made in the prescribed manner
(3) Four members shall from the
quorum for a meeting of Selection Board.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Funds and reports

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
15. Funds and reports.‑‑(1) The Institute shall have a Fund
to which shall be credited its income from fees, donations, trusts, bequests,
endowments, grants, affiliation fee, course fee and contributions.
(2) The capital and recurrent
expenditure of the Institute shall be met from the contribution made by the
Trust. .
(3) No expenditure shall be
made from the funds unless a bill for its payment has been audited by the Audit
Officer of the Institute in accordance with the rules, made under this
Ordinance.
(4) The accounts of the
Institute shall be maintained in such form and or as may be prescribed and
shall be audited once a year. by an auditor appointed by the Auditor‑General
of Pakistan.
(5) The Annual Statement of
Accounts and Audit Report thereon shall be submitted to the Board.
(6) The Institute shall furnish
to Government each year a report on annual audited accounts a report on the
activity of the Institute during the preceding year and such information
relating to its activities as may be asked for by Government.

sections.shortTitle: Dr Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance 1994
sections.description:
Removal of difficulties

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1994
DR. ZIAUDDIN
POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994
16. Removal of difficulties.‑‑If
any difficulty arises in giving effect to any of the provision of this
Ordinance, the Controlling Authority may, on the recommendations of the Board
give such directions, not inconsistent with the said provisions, as it may
consider necessary for the removal of the such difficulty.
